title: Time to show off

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Time to show off.
Welcome to today's lesson: Time to show off! Today we will practice how to consolidate greetings, self-introductions, and basic Q&A.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Time to show off:
consolidate greetings, self-introductions, and basic Q&A; respond to common polite prompts

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: nice, welcome, excuse, happy, student, teacher

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What is the polite response to 'Nice to meet you'?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Hello, what is your name? Nice to meet you! How are you today? I am fine, thank you.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Hello! Nice to meet you. How are you? I am fine, thanks. Welcome to our English class.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Roleplay a first-meeting conversation with your partner covering name, origin, and feelings.
